maria (docs): Heads up — we're changing the default for the 'affinity' param on POST /v1/generate to 'session' (was 'none'). I'm opening a docs PR to align examples, add a migration note, and update SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/XXXX
aj (sdk): Is this a breaking change for SDK consumers? do we need a shim? :thinking_face:
trent (api): It's technically a behaviour change (defaulting). Not a schema removal yet, but we also want to rename the param to route_preference in the OpenAPI to be clearer. Plan: deprecate 'affinity' -> add 'route_preference' alias in 1.4, remove in 2.0.
lisa (prod-eng): Decision rationale: session default keeps KV/cache warm for interactive apps, reduces cold-token latency. For batch/one-off jobs 'none' was better for uniform routing. We need examples for both.
aj (sdk): OK. I'll add a compatibility shim in JS SDK v1.4.0 that accepts affinity and maps to routePreference. Can you paste the exact examples you'd like in the docs so I can mirror them in the SDK tests?
maria (docs): Pasted examples below — please review. I'll put both curl + JS migration snippets in the migration section. Also updating API ref param description and OpenAPI enum to: none, session, instance.
maria (docs): ```bash
# curl example (new default: session)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"Summarize sales deck","route_preference":"session"}'
```

maria (docs): ```javascript
// JS migration snippet (v1.4.0+)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

// old param: affinity -> new param: routePreference
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1.0',
  input: 'Summarize sales deck',
  // legacy consumers might still pass `affinity`: SDK will map it to `routePreference`
  routePreference: 'session' // recommended
});
```
aj (sdk): Perfect, will implement shim and add unit tests mapping affinity -> routePreference. I'll also include a warning log in dev builds when affinity is present.
trent (api): Please make sure OpenAPI change includes: param name 'route_preference' in path body schema, nullable 'affinity' deprecated string (x-deprecated: true), and update response metadata: responses now include `routing.metadata.route_id` when affinity/session used.
maria (docs): Noted — I'll update the API reference sample response to include routing.metadata.route_id and add a short note: "When route_preference=session, route_id is the cached session router id; used for debugging/regressions."
lisa (prod-eng): Also add a short guidance paragraph under 'Choosing a routing policy' — pros/cons and suggested defaults for interactive vs batch workloads.
aj (sdk): One question: will the response shape change for consumers reading routing metadata? if we add route_id, will older SDKs ignore it safely?
trent (api): Yes it's additive; older SDKs will ignore unknown fields. But add a note in the migration guide so integrators know they can read route_id for diagnostics.
maria (docs): Draft PR created and marked WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/XXXX. Action items I'm taking: 
- update /v1/generate API ref param docs + OpenAPI example
- add migration guide with curl + JS snippet (both new and old examples)
- add "deprecation" callout for affinity
- update example response to show routing.metadata.route_id

aj (sdk): I'll: 
- implement affinity->routePreference shim in JS SDK v1.4.0
- add unit tests + changelog entry
- include a small example in SDK README mirroring docs snippet

trent (api): I'll: 
- update OpenAPI and coordinate deployment window (prefer low-traffic window Thursday 00:30-02:30 UTC)

deploy-bot: docs build passed — preview link: https://deploy-preview-XXXX--docs.redwood.ai/ (CI: ✅)
maria (docs): Thanks — tagging @aj and @trent in the PR. If anyone has objections to rename wording (route_preference vs routePreference), speak now. I plan to use snake_case in OpenAPI (route_preference) and camelCase in SDK snippets (routePreference).
aj (sdk): agree on snake_case in API + camelCase in SDK.
lisa (prod-eng): LGTM. Also add a note to the Dedicated deployment checklist — customers with strict routing policies may need to opt-out.
maria (docs): Final checklist in PR description, will merge after SDK shim lands and CI preview looks good. cc: @aj for SDK release notes.
aj (sdk): I'll target the SDK release the same day as the docs merge and add a migration note in the changelog.
maria (docs): Great — thanks all. I'll post a short announce in #product once we merge.
